Connor — thanks for the quick follow-up. See initial proposal summary below (attached full PDF).

Proposal highlights:
- 12-month commit: standard bundle @ $0.00045/token (approx) — ~10% off our list hosted price
- 36-month commit: $0.00035/token (approx) — ~22% off list, requires finance + commercial sign-off
- Example: estimated monthly spend at 6M tokens = $2,700/mo (12mo) vs $2,100/mo (36mo)

AWS private-offer checklist (short):
1) Buyer provides PO intent and procurement contact (we need name, email, billing address).
2) Redwood submits private-offer draft in AWS Seller Central (we need buyer AWS Account ID).
3) AWS reviews private offer; buyer signs acceptance in AWS (this is the canonical acceptance).
4) Optional: DocuSign for Redwood commercial T&Cs if buyer requires on their side.

Timeline: from submit -> buyer acceptance typically 5–10 business days, longer if buyer needs internal approvals. For >24 month deals add 3–5 business days for our legal/finance approvals.

Attaching: Nimbus_Private_Offer_Proposal.pdf (stub). Also including a draft AWS private-offer link for reference: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/private-offer/draft/abcd-1234

If you can send buyer PO intent and procurement contact, we’ll move to draft.

Best,

Leah / Connor — great, thanks for sending the PO intent. Quick clarifications and next steps so expectations are aligned:

1) AWS buyer acceptance is the canonical acceptance for a private offer. Practically this means: Redwood submits the private-offer draft in Seller Central; AWS routes the draft to the buyer’s AWS account; buyer clicks ACCEPT in the AWS console. That acceptance is required for the private-offer pricing to be enforceable through AWS billing.

2) Your signed PO (attached) and internal finance approval are excellent and will speed our internal approvals, but they do not replace the AWS acceptance step. If your procurement team prefers DocuSign/RFO first we can do that as parallel documentation, but the AWS accept step is still required.

3) Estimated timeline:
- Redwood prepares draft + seller-account setup: 1 business day (we’ll need your buyer AWS Account ID)
- AWS review + buyer acceptance: 3–10 business days depending on buyer procurement windows
- Internal Redwood finance/legal sign-off for 36mo/22%: 2–4 business days (we’ve pre-auth on 22% pending signed PO)

4) Action items:
- Leah: please send buyer AWS Account ID and billing address.
- Connor: confirm if Nimbus needs a separate DocuSign for commercial T&Cs or if the AWS acceptance is sufficient.
- Vanessa: please create the private-offer draft in Seller Central and paste the draft link in thread.

I’ve attached a short checklist for AWS PO submissions.

Thanks all — we’ll queue this for prioritization once we have the AWS Account ID.
